title: Tired Face Emoji 😫 Meaning: Exhausted, Fed Up, So Done
description: What does 😫 mean? The tired face emoji shows exhaustion and “I can't deal with this” frustration. See examples and why it is not quite the same as 😩.
summary: The 😫 tired face clenches its eyes shut and opens its mouth wide in a wail. It means the sender is exhausted, frustrated or completely fed up, often all three. Despite the name, it is less about sleepiness than about having no patience or energy left for whatever is happening.
meaning: “Tired” undersells it. A sleepy person sends 😴 or 🥱; a person sending 😫 has hit a wall. The squeezed eyes and open mouth show a groan of protest, the kind that comes out when the printer jams for the third time or a toddler refuses to nap. It is tiredness in the sense of “I am tired of this.”

Most uses are venting. People attach it to chores, commutes, homework, back-to-back meetings and anything else that drags on. The complaint is real, but the exaggerated face keeps it light, so friends respond with solidarity instead of concern. Stretched words often go with it: “whyyyy 😫,” “nooo 😫.” The longer the vowels, the worse the day.

Like its close relative 😩, it can express being overcome by something good, such as food that looks delicious or a pet being unbearably cute, though this is less common. It carries fewer suggestive connotations than 😩, which makes it the more neutral option for everyday fatigue. Physical misery fits as well: sore feet after a shift, a pounding head, or the aftermath of an overly ambitious workout.

contexts.label: In texting
contexts.body: It is a complaint with volume. “I still have to cook 😫” tells the reader you are out of energy and wanted them to know. Parents, students and shift workers use it constantly. Replying with 😫 to someone else's bad day says “that sounds awful” in a commiserating way.

contexts.label: At school and work
contexts.body: Deadline weeks, finals and overtime produce a steady stream of 😫 in group chats. It is acceptable among peers and usually reads as shared suffering. Directed at a manager or teacher about an assignment they gave, it can look like whining, so some restraint helps.

contexts.label: On social media
contexts.body: Captions like “Monday already 😫” and “leg day 😫” are typical. It is also used in relatable humor about adult responsibilities, such as doing taxes or folding laundry. In comment sections it sometimes expresses envy or longing, for example under vacation photos.

examples.text: I've been on my feet since 6am 😫
examples.meaning: Physically exhausted after a long day.
At the end of their patience and energy.
Overwhelmed by workload and venting about it.

examples.text: Those cinnamon rolls 😫 save me one
examples.meaning: Overcome with craving for something delicious.

examples.text: I don't want to go to this wedding 😫
examples.meaning: Dreading an obligation and complaining dramatically.

combos.meaning: Too tired to function without coffee.
Fed up and irritated by someone or something.

confusedWith.difference: 😩 has raised, pleading eyebrows and is strongly associated with craving and sexual thirst as well as fatigue. 😫 has clenched eyes and is the plainer, less loaded way to say exhausted or frustrated.
😣 squeezes its eyes the same way but keeps its mouth shut, enduring quietly. 😫 lets the groan out, so it suits someone who has stopped pretending to cope.
😪 has a snot bubble, a manga symbol for dozing off, and is about being drowsy. 😫 is about being drained and fed up, not about falling asleep.

avoid: Do not send it in reply to someone asking you for a favor unless you mean to complain about it.
Avoid using it with a boss or client about their own requests.
For serious burnout, say so in words; this emoji makes exhaustion sound like routine grumbling.
design: A yellow face with eyes squeezed into tight angled lines, furrowed brows and a wide open mouth, often showing teeth or a tongue, as though wailing. It looks much like the weary face; the main distinction is the scrunched eyes here versus the smooth closed eyes and lifted brows on 😩. Platform designs are otherwise closely matched.

faqs.q: What does 😫 mean from a girl or guy?
faqs.a: It has no romantic meaning. The person is exhausted, frustrated or fed up and is venting. A sympathetic response, or an offer to help if you can, is what the message is looking for.
They are close and often swapped. 😫 leans toward tiredness and irritation. 😩 is more dramatic and has a well-known flirtatious, suggestive use. If you want to avoid any innuendo, pick 😫.
Not exactly. It shows being worn out or at the end of your rope. For plain sleepiness, 😴, 😪 or 🥱 are more accurate.

Occasionally. People use it for things that are overwhelmingly good, such as “this view 😫,” to say they cannot handle how much they like something. The positive sense depends entirely on the words around it.
